keyFindings: Homepage content is a single Elementor page (post 7322) using SmartMag widgets (smartmag-highlights, smartmag-postssmall, smartmag-overlay, smartmag-grid) + sidebar layouts 50/50 and 66/33

WP Rocket delays ALL theme JS until user interaction — on a fresh load without interaction, news images (lazy background spans with data-bgsrc/data-bgset) never render; extraction triggered the delayed JS to capture the real final state
News thumbnails are CSS background-images on elements (not ) — srcset equivalents live in data-bgset
Ticker is a cross-origin iframe (market.petrotimes.ir, 1920x38px) with its own fetch_prices.php polling; all 15 commodity values currently render N/A
The 'current menu item' (صفحه اصلی) renders black-on-black (invisible) because page CSS overrides --c-main to #000000 on a #000000 header — this is the live site's actual behavior
Typography: Vazir 400/700 for Persian, Barlow for Latin display labels, PT Serif for footer Latin text, ts-icons for glyphs
Breakpoints (from CSS): 1201+ desktop full, 941–1200 reduced, 768–1024 tablet (desktop header swaps to mobile header at ≤1024), ≤767 mobile, ≤540 small mobile, ≤350 micro

reproduction.prerequisites: Node.js >= 20, playwright (chromium) installed globally or locally
commands: node scripts/extract.js               # full data extraction + asset downloads (~4 min)
node scripts/capture-screenshots.js   # responsive + component + interaction screenshots (~4 min)
node scripts/analyze-css.js           # breakpoints, hover rules, keyframes, font-faces
reproduction.notes: Scripts hit only public pages, perform no writes, no form submissions, no auth.
